title: Argentina aims for 2027 launch of RA-10 multipurpose reactor

title: Kairos completes first phase of testing in ETU 3 reactor mockup
summary: Testing at the mockup of the Hermes 2 reactor cavity has validated aspects of the precast concrete shielding design and remote handling and maintenance capabilities to support Kairos Power's Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant and future commercial fleet.

title: Construction under way of second Zhaoyuan unit
summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 2 at the Zhaoyuan nuclear power plant. It is the second of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

title: Key commissioning tests completed at Changjiang 4
summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 4 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

title: Groundwork begins at new Chinese plant site
summary: Full-scale site levelling work for the initial phase of the Laiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong Province has begun, State Power Investment Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six Guohe One (CAP1400) units.

title: Tips from China's 56-month nuclear construction schedule
summary: The President of China's State Nuclear Power Technology Corporation, Ma Yuanhua, shared their "thinking and practice" in developing a fleet-based construction process which now has a target of 56 months for new nuclear power units.

title: Deep Fission completes borehole demonstration
summary: A full-sized prototype of the canister that will hold the Gravity reactor has been installed and then retrieved from a borehole using standard equipment already in commercial service in the drilling industry.

title: Groundwork begins for demonstration Hualong One 2.0 units
summary: Site levelling and excavation work for the second phase of the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang Province has begun, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units.

title: Indiana to get its first power-producing nuclear reactor
summary: A commercially owned and operated micromodular reactor is to be installed at Naval Weapons Station Crane, becoming the US Navy's first shore-based advanced micromodular reactor as well as the state of Indiana's first power-producing reactor.

title: eVinci sets temperature record during zero-power criticality tests
summary: Westinghouse says the completion of zero-power high-temperature criticality testing for the microreactor, which saw it reach criticality at 663 degrees Celsius, is a defining milestone in the programme's build-test-learn development journey.

title: China launches Global Network for SMR Innovation
summary: China Atomic Energy Authority has launched the Global Network for SMR Innovation with the aim of supporting small modular reactor technology progress, standards and deployment "helping make nuclear energy safer, more affordable and more accessible in support of climate action and sustainable development".

title: First SMR funding agreed by European Investment Bank
summary: The European Investment Bank is to invest up to EUR40 million (USD46 million) in Finland's small modular reactor company Steady Energy, whose LDR-50 reactor is designed specifically for district heating networks.

title: US funding for Thai SMR feasibility study

title: Third unit at Changjiang site commissioned

title: Natural draft cooling tower is preferred JEK2 option
summary: A feasibility study of four cooling tower options for Slovenia's proposed JEK2 new nuclear project has proposed a natural draft cooling tower of between 193 metres and 198 metres.

title: Containment tests completed at Lufeng unit 5
summary: Tests to check the integrity of the containment structure have been completed at unit 5 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. The unit is the first of two Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors under construction at the site.

title: Local ceasefire in place for Zaporizhzhia power line repairs

title: Zaporizhzhia reconnected to external power after 18 days
